Card Q&A.q: If I have [Agumon] or [Greymon] but my opponent has no Digimon when this Tamer becomes suspended, can I use this card's [All Turns] effect to gain 1 memory without 1 of my opponent's Digimon getting -3000 DP?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When this Tamer suspends, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if you have a Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
